course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: The client sends minutes; the server checks the contract
goal: Pass 90 as an explicit number and return 1.5 hours with server-side validation.

prerequisites.text: onec.p7; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.

sections.title: A question before observation
paragraphs: A field may look valid while a direct call bypasses its interface checks. The server therefore receives a number and independently validates it before dividing by 60.

sections.title: Clients handle interaction
paragraphs: Button handling, focus and dialogs belong to UI. Infobase access and reliable rules belong in an available server context. Thick and thin clients differ; local success does not prove a distributed design. Specify the target client and permitted operations before implementation.

ЧасыНаСервере receives only a number. ПроверитьЧасы reads the UI field and calls the server; neither form state nor document writing is an implicit contract. Convert the returned number to display text on the client.

sections.title: Continue your own form
paragraphs: Continue your own separate copy with Клиенты, Услуги and ЗаявкаУслуги. The code belongs in the managed УчебнаяФормаЗаявки module, not a common module or startup handler. The form already contains Объект. Append only missing methods; do not duplicate existing definitions or load a full CF over your work.

In the form attributes add ИтогОпыта: String(120) and ВерсияЗапроса: Number(10,0). These belong to the form, not the document. The duplicate-reply task additionally needs ОбработаннаяВерсия and РасчетовОпыта: Number(10,0), initially 0.

In the form editor create the command ПоказатьСервер, select its existing procedure as the action, and place it on the command bar. Append Команда.bsl to the same form module; do not generate a duplicate empty procedure. Link ПроверитьДвеРаботы similarly for the independent task.

Worked setup: open your own saved 30-minute request. For buffer/directive observations set 77 without saving; the callback command sets 90 and version 2 itself. The server experiment explicitly supplies 90, 1441, and the string “90”.

sections.title: Methods for the worked experiment
paragraphs: Only methods needed for this experiment are shown. If a previous topic already added a method, retain its single definition. The course retains the original complete module.

sections.title: The client command and its actual output
paragraphs: ЧасыНаСервере first distinguishes numbers from strings, then checks 0…1440. The number 90 gives 1.5 hours. The string “90” and the number 1441 are rejected for different reasons. No path saves the request.

code.output:

Диапазон отклонён: Да

sections.title: The boundary carries a contract
paragraphs: Do not send every customer to obtain one total. A server method receives minimal typed inputs and returns required data. The client cannot provide trusted permission or price decisions; the server checks its own conditions. Test serialization and parameter types separately from arithmetic correctness.
90/60=1.5 without rounding or document updates. Validate type before range 0…1440. String "90" and numeric 1441 fail different checks: type versus allowed value.

sections.title: Predict before running
paragraphs: What happens to the string “90” passed directly?
sections.reveal: A type refusal. An explicit argument is not trusted merely because a client method supplied it. Displayed message text and the returned value’s type are different things.

sections.title: A file infobase is not a network
paragraphs: File mode can teach client/server directives but does not fully reproduce network latency, clusters or parallel sessions. Separate compilation-context PASS from distributed LIVE. Counting source lines or one local process is not measured network-call reduction.
Create the ПроверитьЧасы form command, bind its existing action and drag it to the command bar.90 displays 1.5, or 1,5 in Russian locale; the display separator does not alter the numeric result.

paragraphs: This is the worked single-argument contract. The new task validates two arguments and additionally their sum.

sections.title: The mistake this experiment distinguishes
paragraphs: Putting the only check in the field handler lets a direct call with 1441 bypass it. Enforcing the constraint inside the server function covers its callers within this training contract.

sections.title: An availability matrix checks context
paragraphs: For each method, list caller, parameters and returned data. Test an allowed call and an unavailable operation in the wrong context. Count calls for an ordinary action. Do not fix context errors by enabling every capability indiscriminately; reduce dependencies to what is necessary.

A file-mode run proves method availability and this platform call, not network latency. Training-edition client/server limits do not prevent this local experiment. Network performance and licensed deployment require separate checks.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: Write the context-free server function ЧасыДвухРабот with two explicit arguments. Each must be a number in 0…1440, and their sum must also fit 0…1440. Return total hours as a number. Expect 2.75 for 120 and 45; reject the total for 1000 and 500. Do not save a document.
Preserve your prediction and code before viewing the reference. The worked example does not solve this new task. Viewing its files does not replace your work.

sections.title: The actual training 1C window
paragraphs: The yellow area is the installed 1C interface; the Nexus lesson remains matte. A command driver calls the same managed form, without a real account or other infobases.

paragraphs: A local file infobase establishes the chosen branches and contexts, not network latency, clustering, all permissions, or learner understanding. Record direct callbacks and physical dialog interaction separately.
